title: Jesus at the Temple
summary: Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work. Jesus at the Temple gives kids a concrete picture of wisdom instead of only a word to memorize. Jesus listened and asked questions in the temple as a boy.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 2:41-52. Look for what God does and how people respond.

tell_it: Jesus listened and asked questions in the temple as a boy. When Jesus was twelve, Mary and Joseph found Him in the temple. He was listening, asking questions, and speaking with wisdom. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: Jesus at the Temple teaches through a concrete moment: a person chooses, God acts, and the result shows what matters. Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus listened and asked questions in the temple as a boy.
age_8_11_explanation: When Jesus was twelve, Mary and Joseph found Him in the temple. He was listening, asking questions, and speaking with wisdom. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work.
Jesus at the Temple shows wisdom through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When kids wonder if learning about God matters, this story shows Jesus valuing His Father's house.
life_application: When kids wonder if learning about God matters, this story shows Jesus valuing His Father's house.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps Jesus at the Temple connected to the actual passage?
choices: Jesus was lost because He was careless
quiz_questions.explanation: In the temple is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: What is one wise response to Jesus at the Temple?
quiz_questions.answer: When kids wonder if learning about God matters, this story shows Jesus valuing His Father's house.
quiz_questions.explanation: The lesson should move from hearing to response. Jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work.

memory_verse.prompt: Let Luke 2:49 be the short line kids can carry after the activity is over.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in Jesus at the Temple?
What truth should a kid remember after reading Jesus at the Temple?
How can the group pray about Jesus at the Temple without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Question Scroll
activity.instructions: Write three honest Bible questions and one thing you can do to keep learning.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use Jesus at the Temple to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading Jesus at the Temple.
